lvl1_goal.claim: Ring puzzle: click left(red) arrow shifts ring colors counter-clockwise by 1; goal = move the single Y block into the yellow bracket slot. Clicks cost 5 units of left green budget bar (64 start).

lvl2_mech.claim: Level2: overlapping cyclic tracks (big perimeter ring 26 cells + two 10-cell rows). Red arrow=shift -1, green=+1 along its own loop; blocks at shared cells move with either loop. Goal: all Y blocks onto yellow bracket cells.

lvl6_model.claim: Lvl6 stars c=(3,3),(3,13),(13,8): E-arrow cycles spoke inner>mid>outer; S-arrow shifts 3 rings -1 (order E,SE,S,SW,W,NW,N,NE). 4th loop: (6,6),(6,10),(10,8)+brackets (7,7),(7,9),(9,8). Left bar=budget.
